finding: Allocated ROM/SRAM sizes may disagree with the address map and documentation
requirement: Declared region sizes must equal implemented capacity
evidence: RUN-0009. Elaborated inventory (asic/synthesis/memory_audit.ys): ROM 16384x32 = 65536 B, TCM 8192x32 = 32768 B, SRAM 65536x32 = 262144 B, plus an 18 B APB decode LUT and two register-based arrays. The address map (has_addr_map.sv), the interconnect decode literals (axi_lite_interconnect.sv:114-120), firmware/bare_metal/linker.ld and FR-MEM-001 all specify 16 KiB / 32 KiB / 128 KiB, so the ROM array is 4x and the SRAM array 2x the aperture they are decoded into. The surplus is unreachable: an area and macro-sizing defect, not a functional one. scripts/eda/audit_memory.js fails on any drift between the four descriptions (7/7 controls).
next_action: Decide the authoritative size: shrink the arrays (boot_rom ADDR_WIDTH 14, sram ADDR_WIDTH 17) or enlarge the map, linker and requirements to 64 KiB / 256 KiB; then size the macro. Functional RTL was not modified in this audit.
